## Config Properties

| Property          | Type                               | Description                                                                                                                   | Default                      |
|:------------------|:-----------------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:-----------------------------|
| Next              | `func(fiber.Ctx) bool`             | Skip middleware when returns true                                                                                             | `nil`                        |
| CookieName        | `string`                           | CSRF cookie name                                                                                                              | `"csrf_"`                    |
| CookieDomain      | `string`                           | CSRF cookie domain                                                                                                            | `""`                         |
| CookiePath        | `string`                           | CSRF cookie path                                                                                                              | `""`                         |
| CookieSecure      | `bool`                             | HTTPS only cookie (**required for production**)                                                                               | `false`                      |
| CookieHTTPOnly    | `bool`                             | Prevent JavaScript access (**use `false` for SPAs**)                                                                          | `false`                      |
| CookieSameSite    | `string`                           | SameSite attribute (**use "Lax" or "Strict"**)                                                                                | `"Lax"`                      |
| CookieSessionOnly | `bool`                             | Session-only cookie (expires on browser close)                                                                                | `false`                      |
| IdleTimeout       | `time.Duration`                    | Token expiration time, counted from its last use. In session mode behind the session middleware, a token is renewed only once less than half of it is left, so there it stays valid for at least half of `IdleTimeout` and at most `IdleTimeout` after its last use (set twice the idle window you want), and the cookie expires with it; a request that finds its token fresh does not count as a change of the session, so its save cannot override a change another request stored meanwhile, while the session middleware still writes the session back on every request to slide its idle timeout. Without the session middleware in front, the token is renewed and the session saved on every request. | `30 * time.Minute`           |
| KeyGenerator      | `func() string`                    | Token generation function                                                                                                     | `utils.SecureToken`               |
| ErrorHandler      | `fiber.ErrorHandler`               | Custom error handler                                                                                                          | `defaultErrorHandler`        |
| Extractor         | `extractors.Extractor`             | Token extraction method with metadata                                                                                         | `extractors.FromHeader("X-Csrf-Token")` |

### Config Properties

| Property            | Type                        | Description                 | Default                                    |
|---------------------|-----------------------------|-----------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| `Store`             | `*session.Store`            | Pre-built session store (use when you need to share/register types) | `nil` (auto-created)                       |
| `Storage`           | `fiber.Storage`             | Session storage backend (used when creating a store if `Store` is nil) | `memory.New()`                             |
| `Extractor`         | `extractors.Extractor`      | Session ID extraction       | `extractors.FromCookie("session_id")`     |
| `KeyGenerator`      | `func() string`             | Session ID generator        | `utils.SecureToken`                             |
| `IdleTimeout`       | `time.Duration`             | Inactivity timeout          | `30 * time.Minute`                         |
| `AbsoluteTimeout`   | `time.Duration`             | Maximum session duration    | `0` (unlimited)                            |
| `CookieSecure`      | `bool`                      | HTTPS only                  | `false`                                    |
| `CookieHTTPOnly`    | `bool`                      | No JavaScript access        | `false`                                    |
| `CookieSameSite`    | `string`                    | SameSite mode: `Disabled`, `Lax`, `Strict`, or `None` | `"Lax"`                    |
| `CookiePath`        | `string`                    | Cookie path                 | `""`                                       |
| `CookieDomain`      | `string`                    | Cookie domain               | `""`                                       |
| `CookieSessionOnly` | `bool`                      | Session cookie              | `false`                                    |
| `Next`              | `func(fiber.Ctx) bool`      | Skip middleware when returns true | `nil`                                  |
| `ErrorHandler`      | `func(fiber.Ctx, error)`    | Called when the session cannot be loaded from the storage, in which case the request is not passed on, or cannot be saved after the handler returns. A custom handler has to write the response: one that only logs answers an empty `200` after a load failure and leaves the route handler's response in place after a save failure. The default logs the error and responds with `500 Internal Server Error` | `DefaultErrorHandler`                      |

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
